notes.title: Amanda The Adventurer 3 is coming...
notes.content:
The end is nigh.

In Amanda the Adventurer 3, continue Riley Park’s journey, immediately following the events of the previous game, as they discover the truth behind the ongoing mysteries surrounding Amanda and Hameln.

In the final game, play through a return to form, taking the best elements of both previous games to create an experience that is bound to thrill both returning and new players alike.

The Steam Page is finally here! So watch the trailer, and don't forget to wishlist Amanda The Adventurer 3.


[previewyoutube=jO4aBp8OYMA;full]https://youtu.be/jO4aBp8OYMA[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Amanda the Adventurer 2 is Out Now!
notes.content:

Amanda is back with another adventure full of fun, games, and unimaginable horrors.

Join Riley once more as they delve deeper into the mysteries of the tapes, and explore the brand new location of the Kensdale Public Library to unearth the dark secrets it's hiding.

notes.title: My Friendly Neighborhood Launches on Steam!
notes.content:
From the same publisher as Amanda the Adventurer comes a new nostalgic terror in your neighborhood!

Something's not quite right at the long abandoned Sunrise TV Studio Lot...

Get ready to confront your deepest fears as the puppets of your fondest memories turn on not just each other but you too! Step into a world of childhood nostalgia turned nightmarish with the highly anticipated release of My Friendly Neighborhood! 

The cast of MFN is ready to meet you, but be careful and don't get too close!
